scope: Bounded original-game source profiles and descriptive feel metrics from actual recorded transitions under the existing Jeeves game owner
evidence: Every source mechanic distinguishes authored design, declared source claims and measured trace evidence. Cartridge metadata, lexical cues and authored analogs never become measured original-game behavior.
sources: Exact origin, source and bundle digests plus rights/provenance references are retained. The application source owner performs current tenant/source/withdrawal admission; this pure analyzer does not issue authority.
